title: JournalEntryBatchDistributionDataPagedResult
description: A single page of records along with the token used to request the following page.

continuation_token.description:
The token used to request the following page, or null when this is the last page. Pass it back
unmodified. A page can contain fewer records than requested, or none at all, and still return a
token, so use the presence of this token rather than the number of records to decide whether to
continue. A token is intended for continuing a traversal that is already in progress; it should
not be stored and reused later.

has_more.description: Whether a following page is available. Equivalent to checking whether the continuation_token field is present.

id.description: The unique identifier of the distribution

line_number.description: The line number of the distribution within the batch

account_number.description: The account number the distribution was posted against

account_name.description: The name of the account the distribution was posted against

project_description.description: The description of the project associated with the distribution

debit_amount.description: The debit amount of the distribution

credit_amount.description: The credit amount of the distribution

post_date.description: The date the distribution was posted

journal_name.description: The name of the journal the distribution was posted to

journal_reference.description: The journal reference of the distribution

transaction_id.description: The identifier of the transaction that produced the distribution

distribution_id.description: The unique identifier of the distribution

JournalEntryBatchDistributionData.description: Represents a single general ledger distribution line belonging to a post to general ledger batch
